### QGIS India User Group

We are a community of QGIS users passionate about open-source geospatial technology. Our mission is to promote the use of QGIS, share knowledge, and support each other in our geospatial projects.

*   Shared space for QGIS users across India.
*   Encourage knowledge sharing, mentorship, and collaboration.
*   Organize local meetups, workshops, and learning initiatives.
*   Strengthen India's contribution to the global QGIS project.

::: {.pill-row}
[Visit Website](https://in.qgis.org/){.pill-btn .pill-solid}
[Join Telegram](https://t.me/+YVUWbgjA320wZGU1){.pill-btn}
:::

### GEE AI Assistant: 4k+ Global Users!
**Google Earth Engine Coding Companion**

Empowering the geospatial community with AI! I am proud to share that the **GEE AI Assistant** has reached over **4,000+ worldwide users** across **134 countries**.

My Gemini-powered assistant helps researchers and developers write Earth Engine code faster and more efficiently. Thank you to my global users for being part of this innovation journey!

### ISRO–ESA–GEOGLAM Workshop on Agricultural Monitoring (AM-SEO)
**“Workshop and Technical Demonstration on Agricultural Monitoring using Space-based Earth Observation”**

::: {.event-meta}
**📍 Location:** Space Applications Centre (SAC), ISRO, Ahmedabad
**📅 Date:** <span class="event-date" data-end="2026-12-04">30 November – 4 December 2026</span>
:::

Jointly organized by ISRO, the European Space Agency (ESA) and GEOGLAM. A two-day open workshop on operational crop monitoring, satellite data synergies and early warning, followed by three days of technical demonstrations and training on ESA WorldCereal and ISRO crop-estimation workflows.

**📅 Programme:**

*   **Open workshop:** 30 November – 1 December 2026
*   **Technical demonstrations & training:** 2 – 4 December 2026 (by invitation only)
*   **Contact:** [am-seo@sac.isro.gov.in](mailto:am-seo@sac.isro.gov.in)

::: {.pill-row}
[Register](https://forms.cloud.microsoft/e/yNzvJ1KyiM){.pill-btn .pill-solid}
[Workshop Page](https://geoglam.org/india-workshop-2026/){.pill-btn}
[Download Flyer (PDF)](social/2026-11_isro-esa-geoglam-am-seo-workshop.pdf){.pill-btn}
:::

### InGARSS 2026: IEEE India Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium
**Theme: “Digital Earth – Modeling, Mapping, and Monitoring”**

::: {.event-meta}
**📍 Location:** Hyderabad, India
**📅 Date:** <span class="event-date" data-end="2026-12-04">1 – 4 December 2026</span>
:::

The flagship regional conference of the IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Society (GRSS). Tracks cover agriculture, forest and environment; digital mapping and cartography; disaster management and early warning; and machine learning and AI for Digital Earth, with a special scientific theme on NISAR.

**📅 Key Dates:**

*   **Paper submission:** <span class="deadline-date" data-date="2026-05-30">30 May 2026</span> (closed; registration to attend is on the website)

### XXII INQUA Congress 2027 India
**“Quaternary Science As Societal Services”**

::: {.event-meta}
**📍 Location:** Lucknow, India
**📅 Date:** <span class="event-date" data-end="2027-02-03">28 January – 3 February 2027</span>
:::

The congress of the International Union for Quaternary Research (INQUA), one of the world's largest gatherings in Quaternary science, with sessions, workshops and field trips across the Himalaya, the Indo-Gangetic plains, the arid west and India's coasts.

**📅 Key Dates:**

*   **Regular registration:** <span class="deadline-date" data-date="2026-09-25">closed 25 September 2026</span>
*   **Pre-congress field trips:** 20 – 27 January 2027
*   **On-site registration & icebreaker:** <span class="deadline-date" data-date="2027-01-27">27 January 2027</span>

### EGU General Assembly 2027
**European Geosciences Union: Earth, planetary and space sciences**

::: {.event-meta}
**📍 Location:** Austria Center Vienna, Austria & Online
**📅 Date:** <span class="event-date" data-end="2027-04-09">4 – 9 April 2027</span>
:::

Europe's largest geoscience meeting, held in a hybrid format, with sessions spanning geomorphology, hydrology, natural hazards, climate and Earth observation. Online participation is available for those who cannot travel.

**📅 Key Dates:**

*   **Financial support requests:** <span class="deadline-date" data-date="2026-12-01">1 December 2026</span>
*   **Abstract submission:** <span class="deadline-date" data-date="2027-01-12">12 January 2027, 13:00 CET</span>

### IGARSS 2027: IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium
**Theme: “Global Vision for a Changing Planet”**

::: {.event-meta}
**📍 Location:** Harpa Concert Hall & Conference Centre, Reykjavík, Iceland
**📅 Date:** <span class="event-date" data-end="2027-07-16">11 – 16 July 2027</span>
:::

The 47th IGARSS, the flagship symposium of the IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Society. Submit a full 4-page paper (published in IEEE Xplore), an abstract, or a recently published Q1 journal article (published after 1 January 2026).

**📅 Key Dates:**

*   **Submission portal opened:** 10 November 2026
*   **Final submission deadline:** <span class="deadline-date" data-date="2027-01-11">11 January 2027</span>

::: {.pill-row}
[Call for Papers](https://2027.ieeeigarss.org/call_for_papers.php){.pill-btn .pill-solid}

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const today = new Date();
    today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    const parse = function (s) { return new Date(s + 'T00:00:00'); };
    document.querySelectorAll('.deadline-date').forEach(function (el) {
        const passed = parse(el.getAttribute('data-date')) < today;
        el.classList.add(passed ? 'deadline-closed' : 'deadline-open');
        el.title = passed ? 'Deadline passed' : 'Deadline open';
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.event-date').forEach(function (el) {
        if (parse(el.getAttribute('data-end')) < today) {
            const badge = document.createElement('span');
            badge.className = 'event-over';
            badge.textContent = 'Completed';
            el.after(' ', badge);
        }
    });
});
</script>

:::
